title: Implement the clean-generation runtime vertical slice
purpose: Implement the bounded browser runtime and accessible UI for strict learnit.kit.v2 validation, atomic import planning, isolated IndexedDB persistence, library projection, QCM/fill sessions and progress recovery. The work must fit the exact runtime paths and may not create build, workflow, fixture, test, authoring or contract files.
invariants: The frozen learnit.kit.v2 schema is consumed but not changed.
Only localStorage keys beginning learnit.next.v1. and IndexedDB database learnit_next_v1 may be used.
RC718 storage keys and learnit_durable_library_v1 are never opened for mutation, read as product input, cleared or upgraded.
Legacy packages fail before any transient or durable library mutation.
Package import commits packages, courses and initial metadata atomically.
QCM answers use choiceId and fill answers use explicit slotId/tokenId with maxUses enforcement.
The visible UI and window.__LEARNIT_NEXT_TEST__ use the same runtime and storage paths.
No capability outside the ARC-WP-022 foundation slice is introduced.
No file outside the 14 exact allowed paths is created or changed.
requiredEvidence: Exact changed-path report equals a subset of the 14 allowed paths.
Runtime self-checks demonstrate canonicalization, identity validation, semantic references and atomic import planning.
Storage report identifies only learnit.next.v1. and learnit_next_v1 namespaces.
Manual static review finds no RC718 storage key or database literal in successor runtime files.
The role-local validation commands and raw outputs are recorded and independently reproduced before integration.
The result is independently reviewed before integration.
adversarialTests: Malformed JSON, legacy contract and semantic reference errors produce no import write.
Duplicate IDs and revision digest conflicts are rejected.
QCM choice reordering does not change correctness semantics.
Fill token reuse cannot exceed maxUses.
IndexedDB write failure aborts the import transaction.
The test API cannot bypass visible product validation or storage rules.
nonGoals: Creating golden kits or authoring tools.
Creating tests, build scripts, manifests, workflows or release tools.
Adding media, matching, ordering, classification, flashcards, bilan, mastery, retention, patches or adaptation.
Implementing any backend or remote capability.
independentReview: Architecture review of module boundaries and dependency direction.
Security review of HTML rendering, input handling and storage namespace use.
Contradictory QA execution through QA-WP-011 fixtures and tests.
Integrator verifies that no role-owned file requires silent repair.

execution.validationPolicy: The existing fixed Remote Agent profiles do not certify learnit-next behavior. Any Remote Agent status is transport evidence only; role-local commands and outputs must be recorded and independently reproduced before integration.

rollback: Discard or revert the runtime-only result. No RC718 file, data, workflow or artifact is affected, and no successor build is promoted by this package.
